formal_statement: ∀ (x1 x2 : ℕ) (x3 x4 : Finset (Fin x1 × Fin x2)) (x5 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∀ (x6 x7 : Fin x1) (x8 x9 : Fin x2), x6 ≠ x7 → x8 ≠ x9 → ¬((x6, x8) ∈ x3 ∧ (x6, x9) ∈ x3 ∧ (x7, x8) ∈ x3 ∧ (x7, x9) ∈ x3)) → PEqualNP.TopForm.IsAO2 (x1 + x2) x5 → (∀ (x8 : Fin (x1 + x2) → Bool), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (x1 + x2) x5 x8 = Decidable.decide (∃ (x9 : Fin x1) (x10 : Fin x2), (x9, x10) ∈ x3 ∧ x8 (Fin.castAdd x2 x9) = Bool.true ∧ x8 (Fin.natAdd x1 x10) = Bool.true)) → x4 ⊆ x3 → (∀ x10 ∈ x4, ∀ x12 ∈ x4, x10.1 = x12.1 → x10 = x12) → (∀ x11 ∈ x4, ∀ x13 ∈ x4, x11.2 = x13.2 → x11 = x13) → x3.card + x4.card ≤ x5.size + (1 : ℕ)
plain_statement: For any point-line incidence E in which no two points share two lines, every AND/OR circuit with each gate reading exactly two earlier wires that computes its incidence function has at least |E| + |M| - 1 gates, for every matching M of incident pairs (no two sharing a point or a line).
